A '''giant stone chess set''' was located on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]]. This monumental compound had been built to celebrate the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|victory]] of the inhabitants of Naboo over the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
This monument was built to commemorate the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|victory]] of the united [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Naboo (people)/Legends|people]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|armies]]<ref name="SWD">''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''</ref> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

After the advent of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] sought to replace the banned [[Podracing/Legends|podraces]] with deadly demolition derbies. One of those brutal contest took place on Naboo, using this monument as an arena.<ref name="SWD" />

==Layout==
The center area of this monumental compound was a large square checkered board with statues of Gungan soldiers as white pieces and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s as black pieces. The outer area was a winding corridor that could be accessed by several grand staircases from the lower level. The corridor was overlooked by a statue holding a giant [[Booma/Legends|booma]].<ref name="SWD" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Demolition]]''
